name: invalid_event
invariant: A malformed or inadmissible continuation (here, popping an object no longer in Omega) is rejected without partially mutating the already-committed history.
explanation: After Pop(1) succeeds, a second Pop(1) is inadmissible because 1 has left Omega. The Arbiter must reject it atomically -- the history length before and after the rejected proposal must be identical, and Omega/committed must be unaffected by the attempted (and refused) proposal.
